name: zuuvy-site
description: Zuuvy Sites — an AI-first website platform: landing pages, portfolios and stores, with templates, plugins and data integrations.

scripts.db:reset: bash scripts/db.sh reset && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n studio,site,worker,zuuvy -c blue,green,yellow,magenta "npm run dev -w @zsite/studio" "npm run dev -w @zsite/renderer" "npm run worker" "npm run mock:zuuvy"
